description: Apple Pages on macOS via a use.computer remote sandbox. Pages 14.5 is preinstalled at /Applications/Pages.app on the base-macos image, so install_pages.sh only verifies the bundle. setup_pages.sh suppresses the persistent 'New Version of Pages Available' modal (the base image ships Pages 14.5 but Apple now prompts to upgrade to Pages 15 on every launch — unsuppressed it blocks document editing) and writes a deterministic preference baseline (no autocorrect / dash substitution that could rewrite typed phrases). Tasks cover document creation, body-text editing, and file-system save flows — verified via direct AppleScript queries against the live Pages app (`tell application "Pages"`; works over SSH — see evidence_docs/ where AppleScript reads return full body text from a real run) plus file-existence checks under ~/Documents/.
